audit.why: Early lane favors Sylas (melee-weak Azir, 54.8% WR over 1427 games); late flips to Azir at 2+ items via soldier zoning and Emperor's Divide. Content layer states this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says 'Skill' on six rows while the packet chart, the win rate and the content layer all say Sylas 1-6 and Azir at 2+ items.
audit.why: Azir E is 22s at rank 1 and his frame is paper pre-items; Sylas wins every early stage. At two items soldier range and R flip it.
audit.corrected: phases sides moved to Sylas (rows 0-5) and Azir (row 6), whys rewritten to match; content win[] already agrees so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; dos/donts bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles; key interactions (E 22s window, R 120s vs Hijack 80/55/30, Emperor's Divide knocking back Abduct) unstated.
audit.why: Azir Shifting Sands CD 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 is the lane's gating cooldown; his R (120/105/90) creates terrain/knockback that defeats Sylas's dashes and is also Sylas's best steal; Sylas E is 13s, W heal 12s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns; bleed bullets replaced with steal-timing and R-usage facts.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Azir is weak at melee before soldiers stack — walk up, auto and Q-poke; you win the opening trades.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: W joins: lunge his soldier-less frame and the heal refunds the trade — he has no answer yet.

edits.before: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W with passive whirls is the lane's best level-3 all-in nobody respects yet.
edits.after: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W bursts his paper frame — his one out is a 22s Shifting Sands; bait it first.

edits.before: Chain-trade on cooldown: shield in, stun, whirl the passive autos, heal out. The brawl is the plan.
edits.after: His escape is a 22-20.5s E — the moment he dashes to a soldier, you own a 20-second window to brawl.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: First item spike: your kill threat forces defensive buys and stalls his soldier scaling — press it.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Two items on: his soldier zone outranges your engage and Emperor's Divide shoves your Abduct back out — he flips it.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It governs your forward steps. - E Abscond (shield-dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands (E): 22s at rank 1, 16s max — his only escape; the moment he dashes you get a 20-second all-in window. - Your Abscond is 13s: spent on poke, you sit chainless while his Q (14s early) shoves. - His R is 120s — after a whiff, force everything.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is a top-tier steal — the wall peels divers, and its 120s cooldown means an early Hijack comes back for the next fight.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Hijack refreshes fast — 80s down to 30s — while his real R is 120s. Spend the wall on any real fight; it comes back.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Azir wins by stacking soldiers and kiting behind them — and by saving Emperor's Divide to shove your Abduct back out.

edits.before: You are whatever the enemy drafted best: steal the fight-flipper, flank with chains, and let W make their focus-fire a rounding error.
edits.after: Late, his soldier wall outscales you: steal Emperor's Divide, flank before he sets the siege, and end before three items land.

edits.before: Ahead, monopolize: brawl Azir off every contact, steal the map's best button on cooldown, and flank fights with their own game plan.
edits.after: Ahead, deny his farm: Azir scales through items, so freeze near turret, kill on his 22s E cooldown, and end before soldiers rule.

notes: Level chart: full layer carried blanket 'Skill' rows disagreeing with packet chart, content win[] and the 54.8% WR — moved rows 0-5 to Sylas and row 6 to Azir; content win[] already agreed so side-only edits per the chart rule. phases[6].rating lowered 6/10 to 4/10 to reflect the Azir-favored late stage. Emperor's Divide creates terrain/knockback (kit flag) — it defeats Abscond/Abduct mid-dash per the terrain flag; stated as knockback peel, not a % magnitude. report[] left mostly untouched per sweep scope (only lint-flagged fields fixed). sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.wave remain somewhat templated but were left — nothing Azir-specific verifiable beyond what was already written without exceeding scope.
